China Considers Restricting Overseas Access to Advanced AI Models

Chinese officials are reportedly discussing measures to restrict foreign access to their most advanced artificial intelligence models. The move is seen as a response to global competition and a desire to protect cutting-edge AI as a strategic national asset. Major Chinese technology firms are involved in these discussions.
